notes.title: Patch Version 1.001 Released
notes.notes:
A new patch has just been released for ONE PUNCH MAN: A HERO NOBODY KNOWS.
Update v1.001 includes the following:

[list][*] Added “Town FPS” option to the Town Menu.
[*] Adjusted English voice volume during various dialogues in the game.
[*] Updated default keyboard controls.[/list]
